findings.highlight: I'm actually not sure if I should be teaching you stuff like this.
findings.evidenceJa: ちょっと裏技っぽい操作だし…おいおい教えていければいいかなって
findings.explanation: Haruki says the operation is a little like a trick or workaround, so he thought he could teach it gradually or in due course. The translation instead says he is unsure whether he should teach it at all, changing the rationale behind Koharu's accusation that he withheld instruction.
findings.japanese:
「ちょっと裏技っぽい操作だし…
おいおい教えていければいいかなって」
findings.todokanai: "This technique's a bit of a cheat, so… I'm actually not sure if I should be teaching you stuff like this."

findings.highlight: whose reassuring message of "Just got up" let us breathe a sigh of relief.
findings.evidenceJa: 遅番のもう一人は、さっき電話で『今起きた』との頼もしい言葉を聞くことができた
findings.explanation: The absent evening-shift worker has only just woken up; 実に頼もしい is sarcastic. The translation takes the irony literally and invents relief, when the message actually confirms that staffing help is not arriving.
findings.japanese:
遅番のもう一人は、さっき電話で『今起きた』との
頼もしい言葉を聞くことができた。
findings.todokanai: We also got in touch with the other evening shift worker, whose reassuring message of "Just got up" let us breathe a sigh of relief.

findings.highlight: You even got incredibly popular over what happened with the Light Music Club.
findings.evidenceJa: 軽音楽同好会とか、色々出し抜いてくれた
findings.explanation: Tomo accuses Setsuna of outmaneuvering or upstaging her in several matters, including the Light Music Club. The translation changes Setsuna's action against Tomo into the unrelated fact of becoming popular.
findings.japanese:
「っ！
付属の頃のことは綺麗さっぱりですか？
軽音楽同好会とか、色々出し抜いてくれたくせに」
findings.todokanai: "…! Did you forget all about what happened back in high school? You even got incredibly popular over what happened with the Light Music Club."

findings.highlight: it wasn't an event I wanted to participate in anyway.
findings.evidenceJa: 元々わたしなんかが出られるイベントじゃない
findings.explanation: Setsuna says it was never an event someone like her could or should enter, expressing self-effacement or a sense of ineligibility. The translation substitutes lack of desire and removes the characterization driving her concession.
findings.japanese:
「それは…
元々わたしなんかが出られるイベントじゃないから」
findings.todokanai: "That's because… it wasn't an event I wanted to participate in anyway."

findings.highlight: I'll explain once we get away from these guys.
findings.evidenceJa: こいつらから逃げたきゃ話合わせて
findings.explanation: Shouko whispers, 'If you want to get away from these guys, play along.' The translation replaces the instruction Setsuna must follow with a promise that Shouko will explain later.
findings.japanese: 「こいつらから逃げたきゃ話合わせて」
findings.todokanai: "I'll explain once we get away from these guys."

findings.highlight: Economics Department, third year.
findings.evidenceJa: 商学部三年
findings.explanation: 商学部 is the faculty or department of commerce/business, not economics. The line gives Shouko's fabricated academic affiliation as a concrete identifying fact.
findings.japanese:
「長瀬晶子。商学部三年。
初めまして、小木曽雪菜さん」
findings.todokanai: "I'm Nagase Shouko. Economics Department, third year. Nice to meet you, Ogiso Setsuna-san."

findings.highlight: Parents being on some board of directors
findings.evidenceJa: 親が院長
findings.explanation: The partygoer's boast is that a parent is a hospital director or head physician. The translation changes that concrete status into parents sitting on an unspecified board of directors.
findings.japanese:
「ミス峰城ちゃんの言う通り、
自慢話ばっかりでうんざりしちゃって。
やれ親が院長だとか、フェラーリ何台持ってるとか」
findings.todokanai: "Just like that little Miss Houjou said, nobody could stop bragging about themselves. Parents being on some board of directors, owning however many Ferraris or whatever."

findings.highlight: An obnoxious meddler.
findings.evidenceJa: 救いがたいお人好し
findings.explanation: Koharu calls Haruki an incorrigibly good-natured soft touch or do-gooder after watching him help strangers and people he dislikes. 'Obnoxious meddler' deletes the altruistic judgment and turns the line into simple condemnation.
findings.japanese:
関係ない人間にまでお節介を焼き、
自分の嫌っている人間までも助けようとする、
救いがたいお人好し。
findings.todokanai: Worrying about complete strangers, and even going so far as to help out someone you hate. An obnoxious meddler.

findings.highlight: shouldn't I be able to understand just what it is that you want to do?
findings.evidenceJa: わたしが今、先輩にどうして欲しいのか、理解できる
findings.explanation: Koharu says Haruki should be able to understand what she wants him to do now. The translation makes Koharu the one understanding what Haruki wants to do, reversing both the knower and the person whose desire is at issue.
findings.japanese:
「だったら…
わたしが今、先輩にどうして欲しいのか、
理解できるんじゃないでしょうか？」
findings.todokanai: "Then if that's the case… shouldn't I be able to understand just what it is that you want to do?"

findings.highlight: I don't want to know someone I can't understand.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分にとって、わからない人でいて欲しくない
findings.explanation: Koharu does not want Haruki to remain someone she cannot understand. The translation instead says she does not want to know an incomprehensible person, nearly reversing her motive to become closer and understand him.
findings.japanese:
「先輩のことを知るためです。
自分にとって、わからない人でいて欲しくないから」
findings.todokanai: "Because I want to know more about you. I don't want to know someone I can't understand."

findings.highlight: her determination to get the truth out of me
findings.evidenceJa: そんな彼女の真意を問い質そうという思い
findings.explanation: This is Haruki's impulse to question Shouko about her true intention. The translation reverses subject and object, making Shouko determined to extract the truth from Haruki.
findings.japanese:
そんな彼女の真意を問い質そうという思いも、
これ以上干渉されたくないという迷いも、
全て、着信音にかき消された。
findings.todokanai: Be it her determination to get the truth out of me or my uncertain desire to stop her from prying, both dispersed with the arrival of my phone call.

findings.highlight: I love you too, but she's the only one for me!
findings.evidenceJa: お前のことも愛してる。けれど一番はあいつ
findings.explanation: The man says he loves Shouko too, but the other woman is number one. Calling the other woman 'the only one' contradicts the simultaneous love the first clause asserts and destroys the ranking on which Shouko's close-second joke depends.
findings.japanese:
「そしたら、『お前のことも愛してる。
けれど一番はあいつなんだ』だってさ～」
findings.todokanai: "And then he was all like, 'I love you too, but she's the only one for me!' seriously!"

findings.highlight: My eyes get a little fuzzy after a couple of drops slip in…
findings.evidenceJa: さっきから何滴か目に入ったせいで妙にしみる…
findings.explanation: Sweat getting into Haruki's eyes and stinging is rendered as his eyes becoming fuzzy.
findings.japanese: さっきから何滴か目に入ったせいで妙にしみる…
findings.todokanai: My eyes get a little fuzzy after a couple of drops slip in…

findings.highlight: Maybe the irritated tone in my voice as I said her name put her off or something, but after "Sugiura" makes her comment, she puts on her usual glare.
findings.evidenceJa:
俺の、負の感情をぶつけるときの
呼びにくさに配慮したのか、
“杉浦”は、そう言って、やっぱり睨みつけた。
findings.explanation: The narration's joke about dropping the honorific making Sugiura's name easier to say when venting negative emotion is replaced by a guess that Haruki's irritated tone put her off.
findings.japanese:
俺の、負の感情をぶつけるときの
呼びにくさに配慮したのか、
“杉浦”は、そう言って、やっぱり睨みつけた。
findings.todokanai: Maybe the irritated tone in my voice as I said her name put her off or something, but after "Sugiura" makes her comment, she puts on her usual glare.

findings.highlight: sounds rather convenient, although not exactly manly either, no?
findings.evidenceJa: 便利な男っぽくない？
findings.explanation: The question means, 'Doesn't that sound like a convenient/useful man?' The translation misparses っぽくない as a separate negative judgment about manliness and invents a contrast absent from the line.
findings.japanese:
「面倒見のいい人…？
なんかそういうのって、便利な男っぽくない？」
findings.todokanai: "Someone who likes to look out for other people…? Someone like that sounds rather convenient, although not exactly manly either, no?"

findings.highlight: Setsuna definitely made her way out of that party earlier.
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜は間違いなく、例のパーティには出てた
findings.explanation: Haruki concludes that Setsuna definitely attended or was present at the party. The translation says she made her way out of it, changing the fact that the witness has just established.
findings.japanese:
…てことは、雪菜は間違いなく、
例のパーティには出てたってことになる。
findings.todokanai: …Which means Setsuna definitely made her way out of that party earlier.

findings.highlight: Having seen yet another part of my past involving someone else
findings.evidenceJa: またしても別人の俺に遭遇した
findings.explanation: Koharu has once again encountered a different version of Haruki—the decisive, commanding Haruki he had concealed. The translation makes this merely another part of his past involving someone else, deleting the recurring multiplicity of Haruki's personas.
findings.japanese:
杉浦は、またしても別人の俺に遭遇したせいか、
なんだか戸惑ってるみたいだった。
findings.todokanai: Having seen yet another part of my past involving someone else, Sugiura seems to have fallen into a bit of a daze.

findings.highlight: For prioritizing what I requested and not giving me any more trouble.
findings.evidenceJa: 単にこっちのスピード重視のためだけに、余計な心配を掛けてしまったことを
findings.explanation: Haruki is apologizing inwardly for causing the manager needless worry solely because Haruki prioritized speed. The translation instead thanks or credits the manager for prioritizing the request and not causing Haruki trouble.
findings.japanese:
単にこっちのスピード重視のためだけに、
余計な心配を掛けてしまったことを。
findings.todokanai: For prioritizing what I requested and not giving me any more trouble.

findings.highlight: I have some past connections with a few of the girls, after all.
findings.evidenceJa: ちゃんと女の子の方にも裏取ったし
findings.explanation: Takeya says he properly corroborated the story with the women as well. The translation substitutes the fact that he has prior connections with some of them and loses the verification that makes his report credible.
findings.japanese:
「多分な。ちゃんと女の子の方にも裏取ったし。
…千佳が混ざってたのは地味にショックだったけど」
findings.todokanai: "Probably. I have some past connections with a few of the girls, after all. …Hearing Chika was there was quite a shock, though."

findings.highlight: Slipped away from that crazy high-class party
findings.evidenceJa: 付属出身者たちよりも更にブルジョアな連中とのパーティにうつつを抜かして
findings.explanation: Haruki imagines Setsuna losing herself in or being carried away by a party with people even more bourgeois than the University High alumni. The translation says she slipped away from the party, reversing her involvement in it.
findings.japanese:
自分は付属出身者たちよりも更にブルジョアな連中との
パーティにうつつを抜かして、友達と偶然会ったら、
今度は日付が変わるまで飲んで…
findings.todokanai: Slipped away from that crazy high-class party, ran into a friend, and is now drinking with her all the way past midnight…

findings.highlight: she left me a tiny sliver of a chance to hang on to.
findings.evidenceJa: あいつは俺に、可能性を残そうとしてたんだろう
findings.explanation: The antecedent is Takeya, who has just ended the call after urging Haruki to use this opportunity to speak to Setsuna. The translation assigns Takeya's attempt to preserve that possibility to an unidentified woman.
findings.japanese:
そんなふうに、ほとんどない可能性だってわかってて、
あいつは俺に、可能性を残そうとしてたんだろう。
findings.todokanai: Precisely because she knows how unlikely it is, she left me a tiny sliver of a chance to hang on to.

findings.highlight: apart from places like Onjuku, you'd hardly see another soul on the streets this late at night.
findings.evidenceJa: この御宿でなければ、もうアウトと言ってもいいくらいの時間帯
findings.explanation: Haruki says that if this were anywhere other than Onjuku, it would already be too late to catch the last train. The translation changes the transport fact into an observation about whether streets elsewhere would be deserted.
findings.japanese:
それどころか、この御宿でなければ、
もうアウトと言ってもいいくらいの時間帯。
findings.todokanai: Not to mention that, apart from places like Onjuku, you'd hardly see another soul on the streets this late at night.

findings.highlight: And yet, unable to make the same mental progress as her, I can only repeat my tired acts of sarcasm to Sugiura like I did before.
findings.evidenceJa:
なのに、そんな彼女の進歩に合わせられず、
まるでちょっと前の杉浦みたいな憎まれ口しか叩けない俺。
findings.explanation: Haruki says he can only produce spiteful remarks like the Sugiura of moments ago; the translation compares his present sarcasm toward Sugiura with his own former behavior.
findings.japanese:
なのに、そんな彼女の進歩に合わせられず、
まるでちょっと前の杉浦みたいな憎まれ口しか叩けない俺。
findings.todokanai: And yet, unable to make the same mental progress as her, I can only repeat my tired acts of sarcasm to Sugiura like I did before.

findings.highlight: She couldn't just stay exasperated in the face of all the troubles plaguing her mind. She couldn't just brush it all off saying, "This is just stupid."
findings.evidenceJa: そんな苦悩を、呆れることなんかできない。『馬鹿だな』って、言ってやれない
findings.explanation: Haruki says he cannot respond to Setsuna's anguish with exasperation or tell her she is foolish. The translation makes Setsuna herself unable to stay exasperated or dismiss her own troubles, reversing the experiencer and speaker.
findings.japanese:
そんな苦悩を、呆れることなんかできない。
『馬鹿だな』って、言ってやれない。
findings.todokanai: She couldn't just stay exasperated in the face of all the troubles plaguing her mind. She couldn't just brush it all off saying, "This is just stupid."

findings.highlight: stab at her heart.
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜の温かくて愚かな気持ちが、心を抉る
findings.explanation: Setsuna's warm, foolish feelings gouge Haruki's heart in his narration. The translation makes those feelings wound Setsuna's own heart, reversing the emotional impact at the center of his self-indictment.
findings.japanese: 雪菜の温かくて愚かな気持ちが、心を抉る。
findings.todokanai: That caused Setsuna's own tender but foolish feelings to stab at her heart.

findings.highlight: Let go, already…
findings.evidenceJa: 早く、ふってよ
findings.explanation: ふって here means 'dump me' or 'reject me.' Setsuna is asking Haruki to end their suspended relationship, not asking him to release a physical hold.
findings.japanese: 「早く、ふってよ」
findings.todokanai: "Let go, already…"
